FFmpeg / ffprobe in the Windows release are unmodified Gyan Windows x64 binaries.
Version: 9.0.2-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev
License: GPL v3, retained in FFmpeg-LICENSE.txt.

Original build and binary distribution:
https://github.com/GyanD/codexffmpeg/releases/tag/9.0.2
https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/

FFmpeg main-project source revision:
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/946fcce07b
Source archive:
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/archive/946fcce07b.tar.gz
An unchanged source snapshot is also attached to this project's Windows Release:
https://github.com/adrian147258/DOGsc-for-Windows/releases/tag/v0.1.0-windows-beta.1

This snapshot contains the FFmpeg main project, not all external library sources.
External library versions and build configuration are retained in FFmpeg-README.txt.
Source and license information for the included components:
https://github.com/adrian147258/DOGsc-for-Windows/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md

The MIT license for DOGsc Windows does not replace the FFmpeg or font licenses.
